'''Eet Ptaa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] clan leader who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His fortress was destroyed by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], his clan was threatened with [[Death/Legends|death]] and extinction when dangerous creatures attacked the clan. Ptaa hired an experienced hunter to track down and kill the beasts.<ref name="SWG:JE" />
